info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices Retrieval API provides access to list all devices associated with active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows consumers to gather valuable data regarding the devices utilized for streaming services, facilitating better management and support. Typical use cases include monitoring device engagement, troubleshooting issues, and enhancing user experience based on device data insights. Developers can integrate this API to streamline reporting and analytics related to streaming subscriptions.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices for subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of devices associated with various subscriptions. It returns detailed information regarding each device, including status and associated metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the list of devices subscribed under the specified subscription. The information sent in this request is essential for processing and determining the devices related to the user's subscription.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of devices.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsDevicesRequest.description: Request body schema for retrieving device subscriptions. This schema expects a string input, which may represent various subscription identification criteria in JSON format.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsDevicesRespons.description: Schema representing the response for the device subscription operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information
